name: Support Ticket Classifier
description: Routes customer support tickets to billing, bug, account, shipping, feature_request or other. Runs on 0G's own TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b), so every provider serving it runs on 0G Compute nodes.

task.instructions: Classify each customer support ticket into exactly one category.

labels.name: account
labels.hint: password, login, locked, two-factor, email address

labels.name: feature_request
labels.hint: would love, please add, feature, support for, wish
